ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with high-intensity white pixels occupying the interior lobes and low-intensity black pixels defining the perimeter and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white blobs centered on each lobe. Left lobe (viewer perspective) contains four distinct horizontal black finger-like intrusions extending medially from the lateral margin. The median notch is defined by a solid black vertical region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an acute internal angle; the vertex resides at a significant vertical depth relative to the peak of the fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge boundary with approximately 12-15 distinct peaks per lobe, exhibiting varying pixel-amplitude heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge segments follow a concave trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of raised, light-colored circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized at the terminal points of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Right lobe (viewer perspective) displays three prominent vertical-oblique dark linear pixel disruptions. Left lobe displays parallel horizontal black marks extending from the outer perimeter into the white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake scarring across the ventral surface and dense barnacle clusters at the lobe tips.
